videos.desc: In a 3D-animated kitchen a mother finds a flower pot knocked over with soil and paw prints on the floor and angrily points at her teenage son; he denies it and points at the dirt trail, and the paw prints lead both of them to point at the guilty cat under the table.
videos.said: Yo you again what not me look right there Him it was him

videos.desc: A young woman struggles alone with a huge cardboard box in an empty flat until a man steps in; they take one side each, raise the box over their heads together and set it on top of a growing stack, then celebrate the tower they built.
videos.said: Heavier than it looked! One, two, three, up she goes!

videos.desc: In a hand-painted countryside scene, an old grandmother wags her finger and angrily tells off her grandson by the cabbage patch because he left the gate open and geese got in; he hangs his head, clutches his straw hat, apologizes and shuffles off to close the wooden gate.
videos.said: Look at my cabbages! I forgot the gate. How many times? Sorry, Grandma.

videos.desc: At an outdoor garden wedding, a red-haired bride marries a bald mustached groom; afterwards her red-haired son and the groom's son are pushed together, exchange an awkward handshake and fist bump, then hug and join the new family photo.
videos.said: So, you're the new one? Looks like it. Hi! One family now. Boys! Photo now!

videos.desc: A man bonds with his wife's son: he fixes the boy's blue bike in the driveway and gets a high-five, guides his hands to flip a pancake at the stove, and the boy then runs into his arms for a big hug while the mother watches happily from the doorway.

A man in a bucket hat rides a yellow bicycle down a tree-lined park road. An Australian shepherd rides in a wooden crate mounted on the handlebars and a corgi sits on top of his backpack. A police car pulls alongside and a smiling female officer walks over, laughing, and bends down to stroke the dog in the crate while a second officer chats from the car window. Everyone is grinning; then the man pedals away down the shady road.
videos.said: Goso. How are you, buddy? You know his name. That's Goso. Have a good day, guys. Nice meeting you. Let's go, boys.

videos.desc: A graveside in a cemetery on a grey day, bare trees and headstones behind. A family in black coats and dark suits stands around an open grave with a pale wooden coffin lowered into it. A woman in a black headscarf steps forward and lays a single white rose on the lid. An elderly man drops a handful of earth onto the coffin. Two workers in overalls shovel soil down onto it from both sides until a mound of brown earth covers the lid, the white rose still on top, while the mourners stand with their heads bowed.

A sunny back garden with a family party going on: picnic tables set with food and cups, and grown-ups and children all over the lawn. A boy and a blonde girl run towards each other across the grass and hug tightly, laughing into the camera. They then stand back to back, chins up, and an adult lays a flat ruler across the tops of their two heads to see which of them is taller. Other children run past behind them.

A montage of people in the air. Two tandem skydivers hang under a canopy above a patchwork of green and brown fields with clouds below them. A woman swings in a harness under a rainbow paraglider wing over an alpine valley. A hot-air balloon drifts at sunrise with two passengers leaning on the basket rim. Then a group of skydivers falls through blue sky, and in the last shot about twenty of them have joined hands into a single wide ring against the clouds.

A bright living room with plants on the windowsill. A white-haired woman in a cream cable sweater sits on a sofa cradling a tiny swaddled baby whose face is still red and crumpled, only days old. She smiles down at it. A second older woman sits beside her and rests a hand on the bundle, then a teenage boy and a young woman lean in from either side. All four gather around the baby and finally look up at the camera, smiling, the infant still asleep in the great-grandmother's arms.

A short montage of people of one sex at every age, all in a sunny park. A baby boy sits in a pushchair reaching for a coloured stacking toy held out to him; a boy rides a green kick scooter along a paved path past a colonnaded museum; a young man in a black vest does pull-ups on an outdoor bar; the same man flexes both arms and smiles at the camera; finally a father in a blue polo carries his little son on his shoulders while a grey-haired grandfather on a bench waves at the camera, all three waving.

A mother and father stand cheek to cheek in a bright room, cradling their swaddled newborn in their arms and smiling down at it. The shot changes to the two of them leaning over a clear hospital bassinet with their reflections in the plastic and the newborn asleep inside. The camera then pulls back across a hospital nursery filled with rows and rows of identical bassinets, each holding a sleeping newborn, the rows stretching away down the ward.

A family arrives at a front door hung with a Christmas wreath. A man in a patterned jumper carries an iced cake in while more people come up the path behind him. Inside the hallway there are hugs and kisses on the cheek between grandparents, parents, teenagers and children, the hall fills up, and the whole group raises glasses together for a toast.

Two young men who share a flat argue over a full black bin bag and settle it with rock-paper-scissors; one of them lifts the bag to take it out, then the two cook a big pot of pasta together and hold up plates, and finally sit side by side on the sofa with a bowl of crisps, playing a video game and shouting at the screen.

Two young sisters chase each other around the sofa of a bright living room. They then drape a big white blanket over the dining chairs to build a den and grin out at the camera from the gap underneath. Next they face each other across a kitchen counter, snarling over a single chocolate-chip cookie on a paper plate, and finally each of them bites into her own cookie, laughing at the camera above the empty plate.

A man and a woman, both wearing wedding rings, walk together down the hallway of a house carrying a paper grocery bag between them. In the kitchen they stand side by side at a wooden counter, each signing an official-looking document with a blue pen and smiling at each other's page. They high-five in the hallway, then walk to the front door hand in hand.

A baby in a striped bodysuit stands on a fluffy living-room rug and takes wobbly first steps towards two adults who kneel a few feet away, clapping and cheering it on. The film cuts to a bright daycare room where several small children in T-shirts toddle unsteadily between coloured foam blocks, and then to a wide view of the same room full of little children walking around low tables and small chairs.

Phone footage of two young red-haired women walking side by side across a sunny university campus. They are dressed exactly the same: white polo crop tops, blue jeans, white trainers and black backpacks, and they wear their hair in the same ponytails, so from behind and from the front they look like one person doubled. They stop, open a bag of crisps together and share it, then walk on laughing at each other while other students pass on the lawn behind them.

In a living room at dusk lit by a single floor lamp, a young man in a dark suit tiptoes across the rug in his socks, carrying his shoes in one hand. He stops and gives an awkward, guilty grin. A young woman in a cream jumper sits in an armchair with her arms crossed and a stern face, watching him, and a scruffy brown dog sits beside her chair and also stares at him. A grey sofa, framed prints and a coffee table are in the room.

On the covered deck of a wooden houseboat on a calm river at sunset, a young woman in a rust top and cream trousers lies back barefoot on a cushioned bench against a young man in a white linen shirt, who wraps his arms around her; they smile and look into each other's eyes the whole time. A brass lantern hangs from the woven roof and a kingfisher perches on the railing. Palm trees and green fields line the far bank under a pink and orange sky.

In a pink living room in a curved retro style, a young woman in a pink satin robe sits on a green velvet sofa painting her toenails, then sits back and stretches her arms up. A young man in a navy overcoat and suit stands by the wooden front door holding a scarf, checks his watch with a frown and lifts his hand as he gets ready to leave. A Siamese cat lies on the sofa, and a coffee table holds nail polish bottles and cotton balls.

In a quiet forest cemetery at sunrise, rows of plain square grey stone grave markers stand among tall straight pine trees on frosty, mossy grass, fading into pink morning mist. A red squirrel with tufted ears sits on top of one of the stones, nibbling a pine cone held in its front paws, with bits of cone on the ground below. It then leaps down, runs across the grass and settles on a stone again, eating. The light is soft and cold, and the scene is calm.

A sunny cafe terrace high above the sea. A young waitress with a dark ponytail, a white shirt and a black apron stands on a wicker chair and swings a white paper parasol at a monkey leaping towards the table, then holds the open parasol out like a shield. She is protecting a cake under a glass dome and cups of coffee from several more monkeys on the table and the railing. A cat hides under the table, a tourist crouches with a camera, and big white clouds rise over the coast.

Seen from the back seat of a small car in an empty car park at sunset, an older woman with long dark hair and a brown jumper sits behind the wheel, looks back over her shoulder with a calm little smile and points firmly at the front. In the front passenger seat a younger woman in a beige hoodie throws up her hand and protests, then bends forward with her hand still raised. Four iced coffees sit in the cup holders and a tree-shaped air freshener hangs from the mirror.

A young woman in a dark sports top kneels in warm water in a blue inflatable birth pool in a softly lit living room at night, with candles on the mantelpiece and fairy lights along the curtains. Her eyes are shut and her face is tense as she holds hands tightly with a man in a grey T-shirt kneeling outside the pool, their foreheads together. He then lifts his head and speaks to her. A midwife in navy scrubs holds a torch beside them, and a birthing ball, blankets on the sofa and an open medical kit are behind.

On a city pavement on a cold, frosty morning, a young bearded man in a black beanie, an olive army jacket and gloves sits on a sleeping bag on flattened cardboard in a shop doorway, with plastic bags of belongings and a book beside him. A young woman in black with a ponytail crouches in front of him and hands him a steaming paper cup of coffee and a paper bag. He sips the coffee and smiles while she holds out the bag, and his small shaggy dog sits between them. Men in dark coats walk past behind.

An old farmhouse kitchen with a dresser full of blue and white plates and a back door open to a stone yard. An older woman in a wool hat, a knitted jumper and yellow waterproof dungarees rests her hand on a big sack of potatoes on the wooden table, while a hand from the right takes a brown envelope from the table. A young man reads a newspaper behind the table, then lowers it and laughs. A young woman in a beanie steps in from the right and smiles, and the older woman clasps her hands. A fish in paper lies on the table.

An old stone harbour wall on a grey, windy day. A grinning young lad in navy swim shorts leaps off the edge of the wall into the air, arms out and legs bent, falls straight down and lands in the choppy green water with a big splash. He comes up, laughs and raises one arm. On the wall above, three other young lads in swim shorts watch and cheer, one holding his head in his hands, one holding up a bag of crisps. A football and trainers lie on the mossy stone steps, a rusty ladder runs down the wall and small fishing boats float in the harbour.

At night at a rainy football stadium under floodlights, a young player in a red shirt, red socks and white shorts stands at the edge of the pitch by the advertising boards while a woman in a clear rain poncho and red scarf leans over the barrier, hugs him tightly and kisses his cheek, and he laughs. His teammates in red jog towards them, a photographer kneels on the grass, a steward in a yellow jacket stands by the boards, and golden streamers fly over packed stands of cheering fans.

A long family lunch outdoors under a vine-covered pergola by an old stone house on a sunny day. A bald older man in a light blue shirt leans over and pulls a coin from behind the ear of a young woman in a green sundress, who covers her eyes and laughs, holding a fork with a peach slice. He holds up the coin and she points at it, laughing. A grey-haired woman next to her laughs too. The linen table is full of grilled vegetables, peaches, bread and water carafes.

A railway platform at night in the rain. A young woman with long dark hair in a camel coat and brown boots jumps into the arms of a man with glasses, a flat cap and a quilted navy jacket, and he lifts her and swings her round, both laughing. He sets her down, they hug and she touches his face. His suitcase stands next to them and a cloth bag lies on the ground with oranges and books. A smiling conductor leans out of the train door, and travellers with bags walk past.

A sunny rustic kitchen with wooden beams and copper pans on the wall. Two women who look alike, one young and one about thirty years older, stand side by side in white tops and rust-coloured trousers. Each flips a pancake high into the air with a black frying pan, catches it again, and both laugh and look at each other before the younger one turns away. On the wooden island are a bowl of batter, a jar of honey, a stack of pancakes and a dish of oranges, and light comes through a window with an olive tree outside.

A mirror selfie in the dark green hallway of a small flat. A young woman with long dark hair in a mustard sweater and grey trousers holds up her phone while a young man in a white T-shirt hugs her from behind; both laugh and he leans his head against hers. Around them are stacked cardboard moving boxes, coats on the hooks, a bicycle against the wall and mugs on a shelf. A tabby cat walks across the herringbone wooden floor and stops beside them under a hanging lamp.

A stone castle hall with tapestries, an iron candle chandelier and a fire in a carved fireplace. A young man with wavy red hair in a navy jumper and trousers stands with his hands on his hips in front of a gold-framed oil portrait of an old-fashioned red-haired man in a blue coat, who has the same face and the same pose. A young woman in a maroon jumper and black skirt points from him to the painting and laughs behind her hand, and then they both burst out laughing. A grey wolfhound lies on the floor.

A wedding ceremony inside a tall Victorian glasshouse full of palms. A bride in a long satin dress and a groom in a cream suit walk hand in hand down a grass aisle away from an arch of white roses, raising their free arms in joy. Bridesmaids in champagne dresses dance beside them at first, and rows of guests in suits and dresses cheer, clap and hug on both sides and watch from a white spiral staircase and balcony. Soft evening light falls through the glass roof.
